text_block_list.text:
—I was asked to help out with the 
academy-sponsored "Horse Girl Joint 
Mini-Live."

There are four horse girls performing. The 
event is still a ways off, but the freshly 
printed promotional posters have just 
arrived...
choice_data_list: Let's go put these up in various places!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —One, two! One, two!
choice_data_list:
Good work, you're really putting your 
heart into it.

Good work, you're really putting your 
heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah! We meet again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping my 
classmates with their studies the other 
day!
choice_data_list: Ah, right, that did happen.
Ah, right, that did happen.

text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, she was practicing 
dance back then as well. That makes me 
realize.
choice_data_list: I see, so you're performing in this too!
I see, so you're performing in this too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, is that poster... The announcement is 
finally out! Yes, that's actually right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan looks so photogenic, as 
expected. Doto-chan and Ayabe-san look 
great too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard a support 
Trainer would be assigned to the event, 
but...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that ended up being me.
Yeah, that ended up being me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So it was you! I'll be in your care!
choice_data_list: Looking forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.text:
Still, the event is quite a ways away. 
Practicing continuously ever since that 
time... that's so like her earnest self...

A few days later. While checking the 
on-campus schedule for trainers...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. Trainer-san, do you have a 
moment?
choice_data_list: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, are you checking your schedule? 
What perfect timing♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The entry sheet for the next mock race has 
been revised, so I came to deliver the 
update.

On the new entry sheet, "Narita Top Road" 
had been added to the list of 
participating horse girls.
choice_data_list: She's running in it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we were in a bind with an open slot, 
and she volunteered for it—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Her classmates are also getting super 
enthusiastic about cheering for their 
beloved class rep's entry, it seems.

Isn't she pushing herself too hard on top 
of the mini-live? With that hunch in mind, 
I headed to the training grounds—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa! Phew...!!
choice_data_list: I knew it, out here this late...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I see, so you came because you were 
worried. Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm not overdoing it. I 
properly adjust my training volume.
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Would you mind watching my 
dance for the mini-live?
choice_data_list: Eh...

text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she suddenly began to dance. 
Her dancing was far superior to what I saw 
before—
choice_data_list: Amazing...! It's already flawless...!
Amazing...! It's already flawless...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Did that help put you at ease?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've been practicing the live performance 
dance bit by bit since a while ago, so 
I've actually already got it down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's why lately, I can tone down dance 
practice and dedicate more time to 
running!
choice_data_list: You're truly incredible...!
You're truly incredible...!

text_block_list.text:
She says it as if it's nothing special. 
However, it was clear just how much 
continuous effort she puts in day after 
day to live up to everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to your performance in 
the mock race!

Just make sure not to push yourself too 
far, okay?

Just make sure not to push yourself too 
far, okay?

text_block_list.text:
She says it as if it's nothing special. 
However, it was clear just how much 
continuous effort she puts in day after 
day to live up to everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to your performance in 
the mock race!

Just make sure not to push yourself too 
far, okay?

Just make sure not to push yourself too 
far, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will live up to your expectations 
as well! To do that, more training it is!

With a refreshing smile, she headed back 
onto the track—

And on the day of the mock race, Narita 
Top Road delivered a magnificent run...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking about wrapping up soon 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Would you like to stretch 
together if you have time? You must be 
tired from all that desk work!

And on the day of the mock race, Narita 
Top Road delivered a magnificent run...!
